Apiclient Ops Get
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients/:id

Retrieves detailed information about a specific API client using its ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the API client to be retrieved.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and the API client details are returned.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the OAuth2 client.

]
